description: A2 (c220) KDA chunk backward: reverse chunk scan, WY-inverse gradients and the paired-decay finalize, re-authored from ascriptor a5.kda_bwd and this repository's a5.kda_bwd_stable for the A2 facade (tile-vector UB ops instead of @vf, GM workspace rings instead of UB->L1 / L0C->UB). The host only allocates NaN-seeded outputs and takes non-copying views.

saved.note: The nine forward checkpoints, in this order: g_cumsum Aqk Akk w u qg kg v_new h. g_cumsum is the chunk-local cumulative gate in log2 space (natural-log cumsum divided by ln2).

default.reason: The a5.kda_bwd budget, taken as the starting point because the arithmetic is the same. A2 measurements are reported per case; the budget is not an A2 claim.

dk.reason: a5.kda_bwd's relaxation, kept: rounding the log2 cumulative gate before exp2 moves multiplicative derivatives at deep decay.

dg.reason: a5.kda_bwd's relaxation, kept: the BF16 cumulative-gate cache alone gives relative L2 0.115-0.183 against unrounded autograd at deep decay.

finalize_pair.qk_left.reason: BF16 checkpoint carrying the un-anchored pairwise decay: values reach 7e+07 while the mean is 1e+04, so one BF16 ulp is far above the 1e-3 default. Measured on a 910B3: a single element of 16384 differs from the CPU reference by 1.45 ulp (1408 vs 1416), which is FP32 accumulation order before the BF16 store, and the relative L2 is 1.1e-07. The budget is two BF16 ulp (rtol 2^-7). These checkpoints are only meaningful once multiplied by the matching row or column scale, which finalize_post does; the outputs keep the default budget.

domain.block_dim_note: Only 1 and 2 have been run on the A2 device. The A5 upper bound is not inherited (AGENTS.md section 6).

gate_span.note: The A5 stable backward limit 105 is an A5 measurement and is not inherited. The A2 backward gate span is unmeasured; it belongs to A2-12.

domain.accumulate_settle: Every repeated MMAD against one L0C block carries an explicit barrier(Pipe.M) (A2-01 / ascriptor M10-081); no BF16/FP16 splitk below M=64.

derived_from.note: inverse_mm is the bounded a5.kda_bwd_stable variant (D-PM-24); finalize_pre and finalize_post are the a5.kda_bwd_stable midpoint-anchored variants. Arithmetic and precision boundaries are unchanged; the form is rewritten for A2.

changes: No @vf on A2: every vector body is tile-vector UB ops, per-row scalars via Var.GetValueFrom.
No dma.ub_to_l1 / dma.l0c_to_ub on device b3: every cross-side handoff is a two-slot GMBuff ring indexed by one beat, guarded by VcMutex (MTE3->MTE2) or CvMutex (FIX->MTE2).
D-PM-37: the host slice that built g_last from g_cumsum now happens inside scan_fused, and the host negation of the inverse_mm d_vh output now happens inside inverse_mm, which outputs d_w directly.
The 1/sqrt(128) that a5.kda_bwd folded into a host qg pre-scale is applied to the scan seed inside scan_fused.
scan_fused sequences its five products through three shared L0C accumulators to fit the 128 KB L0C of b3, with an explicit barrier(Pipe.M) before every reuse.

workspace.lifetime: Per invocation; stage outputs ordered by the nine kernel launches.
workspace.gm_rings: Per kernel, two-slot GMBuff rings in the launch workspace (scan: state / seed / dv0 / dAqk / dv_delta / dv / corr; inverse_mm: dvh / dw; inverse_dainv: two products; inverse_dakk_fused: tmp / tmp_bf16 / raw).

saved_state.note: Consumes the nine forward checkpoints; produces no new checkpoint.
